name: SINCOR TOA — Temporal Optimization Agent
description: Forecast → Monte Carlo multi-criteria simulation → wave-function-collapse ranking. Submit goals, constraints, and options; receive ranked action plans optimized for long-term positive outcomes. The core differentiator of the SINCOR DAE. Settles in SINC or AXM on Base.

skills.name: Outcome Collapse / Strategic Decision
skills.description: Submit context, objectives, and candidate actions. TOA runs kernel forecasts, Monte Carlo simulation, multi-criteria scoring, and WFC ranking. Returns top-k ranked plans with confidence.
examples: Given current liquidity and three expansion options, which path maximizes 90-day treasury growth with downside protection?
Rank these three product launches by probability of positive net cashflow in 6 months under base and bear scenarios.

skills.name: Kernel Forecast Paths
skills.description: Generate N Monte Carlo forecast paths from time-series and signals for use in downstream collapse.
examples: Produce 500 paths for SINC liquidity and agent utilization over the next 30 days.

skills.name: Ingest Execution Feedback
skills.description: Feed realized outcomes back into the TOA state store so future collapses improve.
examples: Record that the chosen liquidity action produced +12% realized inflow vs forecast.
